items.title: Solve the Rubik's Cube Without Going Crazy! the Ultimate Fool-Proof Solution Guide (in Color) for Children and Adults of All Shapes and Sizes! Includes Follow-Along Video and Mind-Blowing Trivia
items.description: The Rubik's Cube: A brain-stimulating, nerve-wrecking, but ultimately fulfilling challenge every kid (and adult) should overcome. I was ten years old. I was timid, withdrawn, and avoided humans at all costs because of fear I'd be teased for my zits. That's when I was first introduced to the World's Most Famous Puzzle. I picked it up and got hooked immediately. For the next 2 weeks, I twisted and turned my way into solving it. Young Sebastian was so euphoric that he went on to tell anyone who crossed his path about his latest accomplishment! Looking back at this experience, I am amazed to see all the benefits I got out of solving a Rubik's Cube. At only ten years old, solving the cube gave me the opportunity of: Having an accomplishment I could feel proud of (boosted self-esteem)! Did you know that only 5% of people in the world can solve this tiny cube? Making friends! It made for the perfect conversation starter! Feeling I had something I could teach others. Today, when I deliver conferences or have coaching sessions, I get the same feeling I had as a ten-year-old teaching my classmates what an algorithm was. Keeping my mind fresh and ready for new challenges! It's a proven fact! Rubik's Cubes develop Visual-Spatial Intelligence and problem-solving skills! Being aware of this now, I want to give kids (and adults!) the opportunity of solving this puzzle. Looking through the books on Amazon, I found not even one book that was comprehensible, had color images, and used step-by-step methodology. Thus, with the help of best-selling author Gerald Confienza, I developed the simplest, hold-your-hand-as-we-go guide for solving a 3x3x3 cube! In this book you will find: The easiest procedure for solving the cube even if you've never held one before in your life! Color images of the cube at every step of the way! A FREE 20-minute follow-along video course! Email access to me so you can ask me any question if you get stuck in the process! Mind-blowing cube trivia to make your accomplishment that much more impressive! Act now! Add this book to your cart and let's get that cube solved!
